mission: To empower individuals to achieve their health and fitness goals through instantly generated, personalized meal and workout plans powered by AI.
targetAudience: Individuals seeking convenient, personalized, and effective solutions for weight loss, muscle building, and overall fitness improvement.
customerPersonas: The Busy Professional: Needs quick, efficient, and tailored health plans that fit into a demanding schedule.
The Fitness Beginner: Requires guidance and structure to start their fitness journey, seeking clear, actionable plans.
The Health-Conscious Individual: Wants to optimize their diet and exercise for specific goals (weight loss, muscle gain) with data-driven recommendations.
The Frustrated Dieter: Has tried multiple generic plans without success and is looking for a personalized approach that is sustainable.
toneOfVoice: Encouraging, direct, knowledgeable, and supportive, with a focus on simplicity and results.
coreMessages: Your personalized health plan in 60 seconds.
Stop generic plans, start your custom journey with AI.
Achieve your fitness goals with tailored nutrition and workouts.
visualRules: Use vibrant and energetic imagery that reflects health and activity.
Highlight user success stories and testimonials.
Visually represent the simplicity and speed of the AI plan generation process.
doNotUseRules: Avoid overly complex or technical jargon.
Do not use imagery that promotes unhealthy or extreme body types.
Refrain from using outdated or cluttered design aesthetics.
Do not make unrealistic or unsubstantiated health claims.
